We need to produce JUnit 4 test file for NumericEntityUnescaper. Steps: list public methods. The class extends CharSequenceTranslator (which defines translate method). Only public method is translate (overridden). Also inherits maybe other methods but not needed. So we test translate.

We need basic test case: normal decimal entity, hex entity, with and without semicolon. Also test codepoints > 0xFFFF (supplementary characters) e.g. 0x1F600 (😀). Also test malformed inputs: missing semicolon leading to loop? Actually while loop while(input.charAt(end) != ';') end++; This will cause IndexOutOfBoundsException if semicolon not present before end of input. So edge case: missing semicolon - should cause exception or return 0? The code will run off end, causing StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. So test expecting exception. Also test when after &# there is just 'x' without digits - loop will start at start after x, then while condition will read char at end which may be ';' or not. If next char is ';', end = start (same). Then parsing empty string leads NumberFormatException, caught, prints error and returns 0. So test that returns 0 (no output). Also test non-entity input (e.g., "abc") returns 0 and writer unchanged.

Need to capture output from Writer; use StringWriter.

Also test that translate returns correct number of consumed characters.

Edge cases: negative numbers? Not allowed, but parse will treat '-' as sign; but numeric entity negative not typical. Not needed.

Potential null inputs? translate expects CharSequence not null; not test.

Now produce test file with imports, class, @Test methods.

We need to include basic tests and edge case tests.

Make sure to annotate @Test and use assertEquals, assertTrue, etc.

For exception test: use @Test(expected = StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.class) maybe. Or use try-catch.
